en: "That's... But... but..."{w}
"Master Mirco.{w}Swear on that Baltagias of yours."{w}
"Huh? Swear what?"{w}

"That next time, you will win, no matter what.{w}That even without me, you will be victorious!"{w}{p}"We can't have you forever dragging the name of House Lenzer, the name of Lord Dalisiamarte...{w}through the mud, can we?"{w}
note: The {w} falls before the verb in JP; English cut so the verb phrase completes after the pause. Subject 'you' (Mirco) settled by his reply in :448.

en: "Me...{w}dragging Uncle's name... through the mud?"{w}
"Yes. If you stay as you are now."{w}
"Wait! I don't mean to do anything like that!{w}I want to be useful to Uncle too, you know!"{w}

"But does merely wanting it change anything?"{w}{p}"'I want to be stronger.'{w}'I want to be wiser.'{w}'I want to build my willpower.'"{w}{p}"Everyone wants those things.{w}But most people can never turn those wishes into goals!"{w}{p}"They talk about their ideals and feel as if that alone achieved them, and then they just wait for somebody else to fix everything.{w}...Just like you, right now!"{w}
note: The three wishes are quoted as generic 'what everyone thinks', so set in single quotes.

en: "Right now, you have nothing."{w}{p}"You're weak, you're stupid, you're slow,{w}a runty little crybaby who wets his pants.{w}...Ah, dammit! Now I'm getting angry all over again!!"{w}
note: Kept at full force; Zephal drops his polite register here (kuso). Mirco is male per glossary, so 'his pants'.

en: "Isn't that going a bit far...?"{w}
"But you have a future.{w}You can still grow a great deal."{w}
"Really?"{w}

"By your own strength, you change yourself, and the world.{w}Only one who can turn wishes into goals and take that step can become a true lord."{w}{p}"...Your uncle is just that sort of man.{w}Stand on your own two feet, Master Mirco.{w}No -- heir to the house. Lord Mirco Lenzer."{w}
note: kunshu = 'lord' (also the Lord class). Mirco-sama -> 'Master Mirco'; the escalation jikitoushu + Mirco=Lenzer-sama -> 'heir to the house. Lord Mirco Lenzer'. Fullwidth = name separator dropped.

en: "But... even if you tell me that!{w}I can't do anything..."{w}
"...I will be taking my leave now."{w}{p}"You there. That was a splendid attack, but the next time we meet, I will fight you in earnest.{w}Be ready for it."{w}
note: anatagata = the player party.

en: "They're back!?{w}Dammit, and Zephal's not even here!"{w}{p}"Wh-what do I do...?{w}Hey, you'll all lend me a hand this time, won't you?"{w}
note: 'They' = the player party reappearing; 'you all' = Mirco's companions (Zapper, Hess, Elpina answer next).

en: "Obviously!{w}No way you could win on your own!!"{w}
"Fear not. This time, I shall join the fight as well..."{w}
"Thank you, Hess!"{w}
"Oh, fine. Guess I'll pitch in for you!"{w}
"If we all work together, we're bound to win!{w}Dragging Uncle's name through the mud...{w}I never, ever want to do that!"{w}
"Why... why can't I win...?{w}We were so close...!!"{w}{p}"I did everything Zephal and Zapper told me when I fought... so why!!"{w}
"That is because, in your heart, you are still losing, Master Mirco."{w}
note: kimochi de makete iru = beaten in spirit/heart.

en: "Ah, Zephal!!"{w}
"I was watching that battle just now."{w}
"Why can't I win!?{w}I gave that fight everything I had!!"{w}
"Yes. Well, it was not perfect, but it was the most aggressive you have ever fought.{w}Let me see... I would call it your first passing grade."{w}
"Really!?"{w}
"However, something is still missing."{w}
"What's missing?"{w}
"Resolve."{w}
note: kakugo = resolve; recurs through the scene (kunshu no kakugo = 'a lord's resolve').

en: "Re...solve?"{w}
note: Mirco stumbles over the word; split kept.

en: "Master Mirco... you are still counting on everyone else's strength, after all."{w}{p}"Zapper for muscle, Hess for spells, Gurtia and Elpina for support."{w}{p}"'Even if I mess up, everyone will take care of it.'{w}Isn't that what you think?"{w}
note: Mirco's assumed thought rendered as a quoted inner line.

en: "Master Mirco, you are the leader of this party.{w}You hold the fate of all five of us in your hands."{w}{p}"Even if you stand alone, you must have the resolve to fight with our lives and your own on your shoulders -- the resolve of a lord."{w}
note: 'Five of us' = Zephal, Zapper, Hess, Gurtia, Elpina.

en: "A lord's resolve...?{w}I'm carrying everyone's lives...!?"{w}
"You told me once you thought the boss was cool, didn't ya?"{w}
note: danna (Zapper's word for Dalisiamarte, confirmed by Mirco's 'Uncle' in :524) -> 'the boss'.

en: "Yeah."{w}

"Bet that's what the cool really comes down to."{w}{p}"No matter how strong the enemy... yeah, even if it was a god,"{w}{p}"if it means protectin' us and Belnaf, that man's got the resolve to fight without a thought for himself. That's the kind of man he is."{w}{p}"It's a different kind of resolve, but Hilde's got it...{w}and, well, I guess even Zoze does."{w}
note: Zapper uses respectful ano kata / okata for Dalisiamarte, so 'that man' rather than 'that guy'. NEW NAME: Hilde (hirude), not in glossary; no pronoun used.

en: "So that's what it was...{w}That's why Uncle is so cool."{w}{p}"...Zephal. Not just getting stronger -- do you think I can have resolve like Uncle's someday?"{w}
"Indeed.{w}That is exactly why the five of us are here: to help you find it, Master Mirco."{w}{p}"Offer a hand to anyone who tries to stand.{w}That is the way of the knight."{w}
"Whoa, so I'm counted in too?{w}I just tagged along with Big Sis."{w}
note: anesan (Elpina's name for Gurtia) -> 'Big Sis'.

en: "Having come this far together, we're all in the same boat now, surely."{w}
note: ichiren takushou = sharing one fate.

en: "Oh, that reminds me.{w}Big Sis, how come you didn't fight alongside him back there?"{w}
note: 'him' = Mirco (male per glossary), from the fight just before.

en: "Well, duh. Who'd feel like helpin' a master who leans on everybody else for everything? Right, Gurtia?"{w}
note: Zapper answers for Gurtia, deflecting; Mirco takes it at face value next row.

en: "Oh, I get it. Ahaha, that makes sense.{w}I'm sorry about everything till now, Gurtia."{w}{p}"I'm gonna get way, way stronger, and protect you and everyone else, Gurtia!"{w}
"Y-yes. I am... looking forward to it."{w}
note: Hesitation kept; it lands ironically given the following Hess/Gurtia scene.

en: "Now then, I have fetched my sword as well. With this, I can finally face you in earnest."{w}
note: Addressed to the player party (rematch).

en: "I'm gonna get way, way stronger! Next time I'll win for sure!"{w}
From somewhere far off, you heard the voices of Hess and Gurtia.{w}
note: Narration in past tense, matching the pilot ('Miria left.'); 'you' = the player party.

en: "Gurtia, what of the others?"{w}
"They've each gone off to play or to rest."{w}
"I see...{w}Say, Gurtia, won't you have a talk with me? It has been a long while."{w}
"Oh, Hess, honestly.{w}Why, we talk all the time."{w}
note: Hess-sama: honorific dropped because Hess's gender is unknown (no neutral English equivalent of -sama); politeness carried by the phrasing.

en: "There are things one can only speak of at a time like this."{w}
"How long has it been now, since you became the wet nurse?"{w}
"...I learned a servant's duties from the previous head of the house, and was placed with Master Mirco right after, so..."{w}
note: sendai-sama = previous head of the house; gender unknown, no pronoun. Trailing 'so...' carries the implied 'as long as he has been alive'.

en: "I see. About as long as the young master has been alive, then. Mm, so it was."{w}
note: bocchama = 'the young master'.

en: "You still resent them, don't you?{w}House Lenzer... Lord Dalisiamarte."{w}
"Who can say. Whatever could you mean?"{w}

"When this warrior's training journey began, I was checking the backgrounds of those coming along, and I found out by chance."{w}{p}"How you came to serve our house.{w}All because you had such a rare, healthy body..."{w}
note: musha shugyou = warrior's training journey (the party's reason for being here).

en: "That is all in the past. Would you kindly drop the subject?"{w}{p}"It isn't as if anything was done to me. And without lifting a finger, I earned the shining distinction of wet nurse to a future Demon Duke."{w}
note: Likely sarcastic; kept the flat, polite surface so the irony stays as in JP.

en: "...Have you given up singing and your instrument, then? I have never heard you sing, you see."{w}
"Lullabies, yes -- many times, for Master Mirco."{w}
note: Kept the JP clipped answer as a fragment (deliberate curtness).

en: "Your singing voice was so remarkably beautiful, I always did wonder about it."{w}
note: Hess heard the lullabies, so 'your singing voice' refers to them; what Hess wondered about is left implicit, as in JP.

en: "...Hess. Forgive me, but I fail to see the point of this conversation."{w}
note: Hess-sama: honorific dropped (see :558).

en: "It's true that I was made a wet nurse against my will, by a force I could not resist: the wishes of House Lenzer."{w}{p}"But what good does it do to look back on it like this now?"{w}
"...Seeing you hold back from fighting alongside Master Mirco, I thought... well... that perhaps you still bear some grudge..."{w}
note: omou tokoro ga aru = has feelings/misgivings about it; 'grudge' follows from :572.

en: "Oh, so that's what this is about. In that case, why not simply order me again? 'Fight alongside Master Mirco,' you could say."{w}{p}"I am only a lowly, insignificant demon. I could hardly defy a Demon Duke."{w}
"No, that's not it -- that's not it at all, Gurtia!"{w}{p}"...I want you to forgive him. The master... Or at least, if nothing else, Master Mirco."{w}
note: danna-sama = the master of the house; read as Dalisiamarte (the target of the resentment in :572). Male per glossary, so 'him'.

en: "Hah! Is that all!!{w}Then, as I said, why not simply order me to?"{w}
"What I'm trying to say is..."{w}
"Haaaah..."{w}{p}"You steal a person's future, and then ask them to like you."{w}{p}"My, my, one convenient demand after another! Just what I'd expect from the Demon Duke house of Lenzer!"{w}
note: daimakou Renza-ke -> 'the Demon Duke house of Lenzer'. Full sarcastic force kept.

en: "Gurtia... I..."{w}
"Gurtiaaa, you there?"{w}
note: Drawn-out call (~) rendered by stretching the name.

en: "!!{w}...Ah, yes! Young master!"{w}
"Isn't it about time to eat?{w}Zephal and Zapper trained me again, and after all that running around, I'm starving!"{w}{p}"Look at these blisters. Here too!"{w}
"Master Mirco did quite well today. His attack still needs a lot of work, but his defense is really taking shape."{w}
note: UNCERTAIN: JP Mirco-sama can be 2nd or 3rd person. Read as Zephal reporting to Gurtia (Mirco was just talking to her), so 3rd person 'his'.
